name: Gensou Douwa Alicetale
source:
Ginta has a special ability which allows him to transform into a wolf. He doesn't remember when he gained this ability, but since he is a righteous person, he uses his powers to help others. However, no matter what his intentions are, he still looks like a wolf. One day while saving a young girl in distress, he was suddenly attacked by three girls who had fairy tale powers known as ALICE.

After they realized that he wasn't a bad person, they decided to bring him to Grimm Academy and recruit him into their group which operates under the guise of the student council since they recognized that he also possessed the ability to detect trouble. However, it seems that there is someone out there that is trying to sabotage them. Thus begins the first page in a new fairy tale.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/11/01/november-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
银太拥有一种能变身为狼的特殊能力。他不记得自己是何时获得这种能力的，但因为他是正义的人，所以用力量帮助他人。然而，不管他的意图如何，他看起来仍然像一匹狼。一天，在救一个遇险的小女孩时，他突然被三个拥有被称为ALICE的童话力量的女孩袭击了。在她们意识到他不是坏人后，决定将他带到格林学院，招募他加入她们以学生会为掩护运作的团体，因为她们也察觉到他拥有探测麻烦的能力。然而，似乎有人在暗中试图破坏她们。于是，新童话的第一页就此翻开。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/11/01/november-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
